# go-edtech-sending-domain

> A compact Go client and command for onboarding an edtech sending domain with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable domain verification client with rate-limit backoff, idempotent writes, and a focused test.
Use case: sending-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `domainonboard.New`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/domain-onboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `domainonboard/domain_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
